notice: Fictional held-out evaluation data. Alder Crossing, Port Wren, Stone Hollow and every company, date, number and quote in these documents are made up.
story: Signed in 2019 for 22 apartments until 2049. A signed 2023 amendment cut the count to 18 and moved the end date to 2059. The 2024 rent roll shows 18 of 18 leased.

claims.quote: The Town has paid the Owner a construction grant of $2,100,000 from the Port Wren Housing Fund.
The Owner shall keep 22 of the 140 apartments in the building as restricted apartments, in the mix shown in Schedule 1.
A restricted apartment shall be leased only to a household with income not greater than sixty percent (60%) of area median income.
Rent for a restricted apartment shall not exceed the maximum rent published each year by the Osprey County Housing Office for the sixty percent income level.
claims.value: Published maximum rent for the 60 percent level

claims.quote: This Covenant shall remain in effect until June 30, 2049.
This Covenant runs with the land and binds the Owner and every later owner of the building.
The Owner shall submit a certified rent roll to the Town each year no later than February 15.
If the Owner fails to cure a default within 90 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay the Town the full amount of the construction grant.
claims.value: Repay the grant after a 90-day cure period

claims.quote: The Owner shall keep 18 of the 140 apartments in the building as restricted apartments.
The end date in Section 5.1 of the Covenant is changed from June 30, 2049 to June 30, 2059.
This certified rent roll for 2024 is submitted to the Town on February 12, 2025.
As of December 31, 2024, all 18 restricted apartments were leased to households that qualified at move-in.
Every household in a restricted apartment had income at or below sixty percent of area median income when its lease began.
claims.value: At or below 60 percent of area median income

claims.quote: No restricted apartment was charged more than the maximum rent published for 2024.
